Title: Repo and MERN project skeleton
AcceptanceCriteria: Frontend, backend and Python service folders exist; app runs locally with one command

Title: MongoDB connection and data models
AcceptanceCriteria: Models for User, Listing, Application, Test, Attempt created and connected to DB

Title: GitHub Actions CI for PRs
AcceptanceCriteria: Workflow runs lint and tests on every PR and reports status

Title: Test framework setup
AcceptanceCriteria: Jest/Supertest configured; one sample test runs in CI

Title: Register as Student or Recruiter
AcceptanceCriteria: Valid name, email, password creates an account with chosen role

Title: Email validation and duplicate rejection
AcceptanceCriteria: Bad email format and already registered email are rejected with an error message

Title: Login with email and password
AcceptanceCriteria: Correct credentials start a session; wrong credentials show an error

Title: Store passwords as salted hashes
AcceptanceCriteria: No plain text password in DB; hash verified at login

Title: Role-based access to functions
AcceptanceCriteria: Each route is limited to Student, Recruiter or Admin as specified

Title: Server-side role check on every request
AcceptanceCriteria: Disallowed role receives an authorisation error

Title: Admin approves Recruiter accounts
AcceptanceCriteria: Unapproved Recruiter cannot post listings until Admin approves

Title: Recruiter creates internship listing
AcceptanceCriteria: All eight listing fields saved and listing appears for Students

Title: Recruiter edits or closes own listings only
AcceptanceCriteria: Edit and close work on own listings; others are blocked

Title: Paginated list of active listings
AcceptanceCriteria: Students see active listings in pages

Title: Search listings by keyword
AcceptanceCriteria: Keyword matches title, company and required skills

Title: Filter listings
AcceptanceCriteria: Filter by location, duration, stipend range and skills

Title: Hide listings after deadline
AcceptanceCriteria: Listing past its deadline is not shown as active

Title: View full listing details
AcceptanceCriteria: Student can open a listing and see all fields

Title: Admin removes guideline-violating listing
AcceptanceCriteria: Removed listing no longer visible to Students

Title: Apply with resume and cover note
AcceptanceCriteria: Application saved with resume and optional note for an active listing

Title: Reject duplicate application
AcceptanceCriteria: Second application shows an already applied message

Title: Reject application after deadline
AcceptanceCriteria: Late application is rejected with a message

Title: Accept only PDF resumes up to 2 MB
AcceptanceCriteria: Non-PDF or oversized file is rejected with an error

Title: Withdraw application before decision
AcceptanceCriteria: Withdraw allowed only while no decision has been made

Title: Recruiter views applicants of own listings
AcceptanceCriteria: Recruiter sees applicants only for listings they created

Title: Recruiter sets application status
AcceptanceCriteria: Status can be Under Review, Shortlisted, Rejected or Selected

Title: In-portal notification on status change
AcceptanceCriteria: Student sees a notification when status changes

Title: Student application dashboard
AcceptanceCriteria: All of the Student's applications shown with current status

Title: Application status timeline
AcceptanceCriteria: Each status change shown with its date

Title: Aptitude tests attempted per category
AcceptanceCriteria: Percentage attempted shown per category

Title: Admin creates aptitude test
AcceptanceCriteria: Test saved with category, time limit and questions with one correct answer

Title: Browse tests by category
AcceptanceCriteria: Students can list tests per category

Title: Countdown timer during attempt
AcceptanceCriteria: Timer counts down while attempting

Title: Auto-submit on time expiry
AcceptanceCriteria: Attempt is submitted when time limit ends

Title: Auto-score and store attempt
AcceptanceCriteria: Score computed and stored against Student and test

Title: Show result with correct answers
AcceptanceCriteria: Per-question correctness and correct answer displayed after submit

Title: Multiple attempts stored separately
AcceptanceCriteria: Each attempt kept as its own record

Title: Score trend per category
AcceptanceCriteria: Student sees score trend across attempts per category

Title: Weak area identification
AcceptanceCriteria: Category with lowest average score is displayed

Title: Recruiter listing analytics
AcceptanceCriteria: Application count and status distribution per listing

Title: Admin platform totals
AcceptanceCriteria: Totals of users, active listings, applications and attempts shown

Title: Search response time under load
AcceptanceCriteria: Search meets the IPP-NF-001 target in a load test

Title: Scoring and result display time
AcceptanceCriteria: Result shown within the IPP-NF-002 limit

Title: Availability
AcceptanceCriteria: Deployment and uptime check in place

Title: Capacity
AcceptanceCriteria: Load test at the IPP-NF-004 user counts

Title: Usability test
AcceptanceCriteria: Usability check done with first-time users and result recorded

Title: Browser and screen compatibility
AcceptanceCriteria: Works on Chrome, Firefox, Edge and at 360 px width

Title: Autosave test answers
AcceptanceCriteria: Answers saved periodically during an attempt

Title: Unit test coverage
AcceptanceCriteria: Coverage report meets the IPP-NF-008 target in CI

Title: Verify confidentiality of data and resumes
AcceptanceCriteria: Only permitted roles can read Student data

Title: Verify integrity of scores and statuses
AcceptanceCriteria: Students cannot change scores or statuses

Title: Verify authenticated access only
AcceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated requests are refused

Title: HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or higher
AcceptanceCriteria: Deployed site serves only over HTTPS

Title: Session expiry after inactivity
AcceptanceCriteria: Session ends after the inactivity limit

Title: Input validation and sanitisation
AcceptanceCriteria: Injection and XSS payloads are rejected or escaped

Title: Restrict resume download
AcceptanceCriteria: Only owner, listing Recruiter and Admin can download

Title: Account lockout after failed logins
AcceptanceCriteria: Account locks for the specified time after repeated failures

Title: Server-side scoring, hidden answers
AcceptanceCriteria: Correct answers not sent to client before submit

Title: Documentation and deviations log
AcceptanceCriteria: README, updated SRS/SAD/Test Plan and deviations list ready

Title: Deployment and demo videos
AcceptanceCriteria: 1-min and 2-min videos uploaded to repo
